Package hadur2.core.melee

Class MeleeEnergyPolicy

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.melee.MeleeEnergyPolicy
public final class MeleeEnergyPolicy extends Object
Melee bullet power (MGUN-2, MGUN-3), the plan's energy table:
  • a finisher (target energy at most FINISHER_ENERGY) gets the power that kills it exactly, at most 3;
  • with two opponents or fewer left, the duel's own table (1.95, 2.95 inside 150 px, powering down beyond 325 px as energy runs low);
  • otherwise 1.0 beyond 500 px or below 20 energy (0.5 below 10), 1.5 at 300-500 px, and 2.0 inside 300 px rising to 3.0 at 150 px.

Nothing is fired below MIN_OWN_ENERGY, a shot never costs more than what kills the target, and while Hadur leads the target on energy a shot never drops it below the target's.
